scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute thepnakorn-db --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute thepnakorn-db --local --file=seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute thepnakorn-db --remote --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute thepnakorn-db --remote --file=seed/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
